files.pbs.yaml:
host: 127.0.0.1
port: 8000
external_url: https://prebid.example.com
status_response: ok
gdpr:
  host_vendor_id: 52
  default_value: "1"
  eea_countries: [FRA, DEU]
  tcf2:
    purpose1:
      vendor_exceptions: [appnexus]
    special_feature1:
      vendor_exceptions: [rubicon]
host_cookie:
  ttl_days: 30
  domain: example.com
  cookie_name: uids
adapters:
  appnexus:
    endpoint: http://ib.adnxs.com/openrtb2
    platform_id: "5"
    usersync:
      key: adnxs
      redirect:
        url: https://sync.example.com/{{.GDPR}}
  Rubicon:
    disabled: false
    xapi:
      username: user
  newbidder:
    endpoint: http://new.example.com
stored_requests:
  filesystem:
    enabled: true
    directorypath: ./stored
accounts:
  filesystem:
    enabled: true
user_sync:
  priority_groups:
    - [appnexus, rubicon]
    - [ix]
analytics:
  agma:
    accounts:
      - code: abc
        publisher_id: "1"
request_validation:
  ipv4_private_networks: ["10.0.0.0/8"]
CamelCase:
  Key: value
host_schain_node:
  asi: example.com
  sid: "00001"
  hp: 1
metrics:
  prometheus:
    port: 9090
  influxdb:
    host: ""
max_request_size: 1e6
compression:
  response:
    enable_gzip: yes
